linear.text: What was made and why: Ultra-high-strength 32MnB5 hot-stamping steels are -> Mo in solid solution and segregated to prior-auste -> Add Mo to 32MnB5 (Mo steel) and compare with Mo-fr -> Austenitize and quench (hot-stamping simulation) b -> Electrochemical H pre-charging at 0.5 and 3 mA/cm2 -> Ref microcracks run along PAGBs; Mo-steel microcra
Open the panels F7c [SEM] and classify (recognize signature)
Observation: Ref dark-gray region: intergranular facets and cleavage facets
Claim it establishes: H-charged Ref fails by mixed intergranular-cleavage fracture; Mo steel by quasi-cleavage and dimples, no intergranular facets
Feeds: Mo steel keeps far more elongation after H-charging: El_loss ~17/26% vs ~50/79% for Ref
